tasks.title: Decouple scaffold-report build_type from the fixed enum (dir-driven)
tasks.description: Replace the build_type enum in scaffold-report.schema.json with the same slug pattern requirements.schema.json uses, drop the hardcoded enum from the scaffold.js error message, and add a regression test that scaffolds a novel build_type and asserts its report validates.
acceptance_criteria: scaffold-report.schema.json validates build_type as { type: string, pattern: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]* }, not an enum.
A project with a build_type outside the old enum scaffolds and its scaffold-report.json passes validation.
The missing-build_type error in scaffold.js no longer lists (game|cli|app|library|other).
